impact.text: effectively blocking legitimate operations from being processed by the standard ERC-4337 infrastructure.

precondition_sources.text: A UserOperation is submitted whose signature has an invalid length or a high-S malleable S-value (s > secp256k1.n/2).
The bundler simulates the UserOperation's validation phase.

intent_sources.text: validateUserOp MUST NOT revert on signature mismatch; it must return SIG_VALIDATION_FAILED (magic value 1) so bundlers can cleanly reject operations.
